QuestInfo.name: Feeding a Growing Dragon
QuestInfo.0: Mos looks bent out of shape. Go ask Mos about his problems.
QuestInfo.1: Growing baby dragons must eat well to become strong. But baby dragon Mir eats way too much! Go get #r#t4033787##k and #r#t4033792##k to feed Mir as Kumo requested.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the Shell Dragon meat and Manon's Tail meat to feed the growing dragon Mir. Mir might be a growing dragon but still it is eating way too much!

0.0: Yeah, so Mir'll be as big as Afrien someday. Maybe even bigger. That doesn't mean he has to eat SO BLEEPIN' MUCH! He could probably eat ME in one gulp.
0.1: Speaking of which, it's feeding time again... can you deal with that?

yes.0: Bring me 20 #r#t4033787##k items to feed this fella. You know what, get #r1#k #r#t4033792##k, too, just to be safe. Even adult dragons would have trouble finishing that much!

no.0: Ugh... my hands are going to smell like raw steak forever...

yes.0: Meat! Me-me-MEAT! Yummy meat! GIVE ME THE MEAT.

npc.0: Mir's going to eat us out of house and home!
